name: Shallum (priest)
title: Priest in the line of high priests
summary: Shallum was a priest in the high priestly lineage, father of Hilkiah who found the Book of the Law in the temple during King Josiah's reign.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of priests
keyEvents.description: Shallum is listed in the line of high priests as the father of Hilkiah.
